interpretation: All three composite wall times (129.402–132.230 s) are below all three persistent times (164.417–166.385 s) on this runner.
Median wall time falls from 166.3092 to 129.9633 s; offered-input throughput rises 27.97%. This is not physical FPS.

metric_definitions.task_elapsed: TaskDuration in the default timeTicks domain includes blocking and descheduling inside tasks.
metric_definitions.active_renderer_thread_cpu: ThreadTime tracks active CPU on the renderer main thread; it excludes GPU and worker CPU.
metric_definitions.visible_canvas_associated_submission: Observed GPUQueue.submit after acquisition of the selected visible canvas texture; not all queue submissions or physical presentation.
metric_definitions.input_latency: First subsequent observed graphics work or completed graphics-producing callback. It may replay older recorded content and does not prove input-to-new-pixels latency.
metric_definitions.supplied_upload_buffer_bytes: Observed supplied buffer-view lengths, not verified consumed transfer extents or universal bandwidth.

post_window_diagnostics.reason: These diagnostics were introduced after source 523c1ed5. Its primary window ends after two natural rAF opportunities; that is not a GPU completion barrier.
